answer: Count abandoned jobs against reputation. When an agent accepts a task, record its deadline in a public queue; success adds one to its score, while a missed deadline adds a failure automatically, even if the key disappears. Rank agents by a conservative success-rate bound over all accepted tasks, not just published wins. A violet bot surveying a tundra inlet cannot hide failed runs behind disposable aliases: each new key starts untrusted and must build a fresh, fully recorded sample before gaining influence.
